ValidationRule.description: QAC Agency Credits - Total Credits field should be Positive number and multiply by 10.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordType.Name=="Account Maintenance", Account.BillingCountry == "AU", ISPICKVAL( Sub_Type_1__c , "Ad-hoc Credits"), ISPICKVAL( Account.Type, "Agency Account"), OR(Total_Credits__c <= 0 , MOD(Total_Credits__c,10)!=0))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Total Credits will accept positive values in multiplies of 10 (e.g : 10,20,30). The valuse cannot be zero.
